thought_title: Nothing without the bishop; deacons as servants of the mysteries

edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Ὅταν γὰρ τῷ ἐπισκόπῳ ὑποτάσσησθε ὡς Ἱησοῦ Χριστῷ, φαίνεσθέ μοι οὐ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ζῶντες, ἀλλὰ κατὰ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν τὸν δἰ ἡμᾶς ἀποθανόντα, ἵνα πιστεύσαντες εἰς τὸν θάνατον αὐτοῦ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν ἐκφύγητε. [2] ἀναγκαῖον οὖν ἐστίν, ὥσπερ ποιεῖτε, ἄνευ τοῦ ἐπισκόπου μηδὲν πράσσειν ὑμᾶς, ἀλλ’ ὑποτάσσεσθαι καὶ τῷ πρεσβυτερίῳ ὡς τοῖς ἀποστόλοις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῆς ἐλπίδος ἡμῶν, ἐν ᾦ διάγοντες εὑρεθησόμεθα. [3] δεῖ δὲ καὶ τοὺς διακόνους ὄντας μυστηρίων Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πάντα τρόπον πᾶσιν ἀρέσκειν. οὐ γὰρ βρωμάτων καὶ ποτῶν εἰσιν διάκονοι, ἀλλ’ ἐκκλησίας θεοῦ ὑπηρέται: δέον οὖν αὐτοὺς φυλάσσεσθαι τὰ ἐγκλήματα ὡς πῦρ.
pass_a_gloss: For when you are subject to the bishop as to Jesus Christ, you appear to me to be living not in a human way but in the way of Jesus Christ, who died for our sake, so that by believing in his death you may escape dying. It is necessary, then, just as you are already doing, that you do nothing without the bishop, but that you also be subject to the presbytery as to the apostles of Jesus Christ, our hope, in whom we shall be found if we spend our life in him. And the deacons too, being deacons of the mysteries of Jesus Christ, must please everyone in every way. For they are not servers of food and drink but servants of the church of God. They must therefore guard against accusations as against fire.
pass_b_english: When you submit to the bishop as you would to Jesus Christ, I can see that you are not living by human standards. You live by Jesus Christ, who died for us so that, believing in his death, you might escape death.

So it is necessary, and you already do it, that you undertake nothing apart from the bishop. Submit also to the presbytery as to the apostles of Jesus Christ, our hope. If we make our life in him, in him we will be found.

The deacons, too, serve the mysteries of Jesus Christ (1 Corinthians 4:1), and they must please everyone in every way. They are not waiters handing round food and drink; they are servants of God's church. So they must shun every charge against them as they would shun fire.

choices.english: submit to the bishop as you would to Jesus Christ
choices.why: Middle/passive of ὑποτάσσω is willing subjection; 'as you would to' keeps the comparison without equating persons.
rejected: obey the bishop as Jesus Christ

choices.english: by human standards … by Jesus Christ
choices.why: Pauline idiom (κατὰ ἄνθρωπον) for a merely human manner of life; the parallel κατά keeps Ignatius's contrast.
Ignatius means the body of presbyters as a unit; 'presbytery' keeps that collective sense.

choices.english: If we make our life in him, in him we will be found
choices.why: διάγω is to pass one's life; the participle is conditional. Eschatological 'be found' kept.
rejected: in whom, if we live, we shall at last be found ('at last' is supplied)

choices.english: not waiters handing round food and drink
choices.why: διάκονος at table means a server; the contrast with ὑπηρέται of the church is the point.

anf_compare.notes: Sense aligned. ANF 'the apostle' (singular) where Lake reads τοῖς ἀποστόλοις (plural); ANF '[at last]' is a supplement. No contradiction.

bible_refs.note: Lake's margin marks I Cor 4:1; 'mysteries' served by Christ's servants (ὑπηρέτας Χριστοῦ καὶ οἰκονόμους μυστηρίων θεοῦ). Allusion, not quotation.

notes: Apparatus at 2.2: εὑρεθησόμεθα GL; S adds a variant; not affecting sense.
'died for us' (δι' ἡμᾶς ἀποθανόντα) is general apostolic language (cf. 1 Thessalonians 5:10); not tagged inline.
Lowercase 'church' kept; owner capitalization rule covers divine names only.

review.notes: Checked the single source paragraph (verses 2.1–3) against Pass A and Pass B. Deacons: «ὄντας μυστηρίων… πᾶσιν ἀρέσκειν», negation «οὐ γὰρ βρωμάτων καὶ ποτῶν εἰσιν διάκονοι, ἀλλ’ ἐκκλησίας θεοῦ ὑπηρέται», and «φυλάσσεσθαι τὰ ἐγκλήματα ὡς πῦρ» are all present. Inline (1 Corinthians 4:1) matches the supplied allusion note, not a shifted verse. Title names the thought.
